input: # Inputs that are not chess notation. PGN spec 8.2: "illegal moves are not
# real chess moves, they are not permitted in PGN movetext" — this parser
# has no board, so it enforces the part it can see: the notation's shape.
# --- promotion to a king or a pawn is not a promotion (8.2.3.3) ---
# --- 7: a symbol token ends at the first non-symbol character, so a pair
# of run-together moves is one bad token, not two good ones ---
# --- tokens with no place in the movetext ---
1. e4 % escape not in column one
# --- a glyph is a dollar and digits (8.2.4) ---
# --- a termination marker is one of exactly four symbols (8.2.6) ---

# engine's own wording. Both runtimes set the same templates, so these rows
